# How to configure this workflow?
## Step 0: Database
- Press **Execute Workflow** when hovering near the **Initial Setup** trigger node.
## Step 1: Configuring Zoho Credentials
- Visit [Zoho API Console](https://api-console.zoho.com/#web)
- Click "Server-based Application" and fill the form:
```
- Client Name: n8n_znews
- Homepage URL: https://<your n8n domain>/rest/oauth2-credential/callback
    (example: https://kaizen.com/rest/oauth2-credential/callback)
- Authorized Redirect URIs: https://n8n.deltamolfar.dev/rest/oauth2-credential/callback
```
- Click "CREATE"
- Copy Client ID and Client Secret
- Open "Send News" node -> click "OAuth2 API" picklist -> "+ Create new credentials"
- Fill it:
```
- Grant Type: Authorization Code
- Authorization URL: https://accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/auth
  (Top-level domain may be different. Use your DC (.eu, etc)
- Access Token URL: https://accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/token
  (Top-level domain may be different. Use your DC (.eu, etc)
- Client ID: <Your copied Client ID>
- Client Secret: <Your copied Client Secret>
- Scope: ZohoCliq.Webhooks.CREATE
- Auth URI Query Parameters: access_type=offline
  (It's IMPORTANT to fill it, as placeholder does not mean default value!)
- Authentication: Header
```
- Authenticate the Credentials and grant access on the opened window.

## Step 2: Configuring Zoho Cliq Channel
*(you can skip this step apart from last 2 substeps if you want to send news into an existing channel)*
- Open **Zoho Cliq**
- Click **Channels** -> **+** -> Creating a new channel
- Open newly created channel -> **Connectors** -> Copy **API Endpoint**
- Open **Config node** and enter the API Endpoint into the **cliq_endpoint** field

## Step 3: Creating Zoho Cliq Bot
- Open **Zoho Cliq**
- Click on **your avatar** -> **Bots & Tools** -> **Create Bot** -> Enter parameters, but make sure to set **Allow users to add this bot to any channel** to **true**!
- Open bot details and find **API Endpoint URI**. From there -> **copy the API Name of the bot**, which is located right after /bots/. (Ex. https://cliq.zoho.com/api/v2/bots/zohonews/message -> zohonews)
- Open **Config node** and enter the bot API name into the **bot_name** field
- Go back to channel created at **step 2**
- **Invite** the newly created **bot** into the said **channel**.

## Step 4: Publish this workflow
- Click on **Publish** button at the top right

## Step 5: Managing your subscriptions
- Open **https://<your_n8n_domain>/webhook/zohoCommunityFeed_adminPanel** link in a new tab(ex. https://n8n.com/webhook/zohoCommunityFeed_adminPanel)
- Select desired forums, or their subforms, and click "Save Changes"
- Optionally (**but HIGHLY recommended**) - disable the **Load Admin Panel** and **Save Subscription Data** nodes, so no one else can change your settings

# Initial Setup #1
Just click here once to create database tables requires for this workflow

## Admin panel
Handles rendering of the admin panel, and accepting updates from it

# Initial Setup #2
Make sure to put your desired frequency of execution and chat API endpoint/bot name

## Preparing Polling Data
Getting portalId which is required for all ZCC requests, subscription data to only poll required categories, and beginning the loop of the category

## Getting Last View Date of a category
So that later on we can filter out and send only new announcements

## Fetching the latest news from Zoho Community Center
We're batching the requests by 1300ms so that we do not hit **419 Too many requests** error both at fetching and at **Send Announcement to Zoho Cliq** node

## Filter out already sent announcements
Compare created time of an announcement to last view date, and decide if it should be sent to the Zoho Cliq channel or skipped

## Sending Announcements
Sending found announcements to Zoho Cliq chat via the bot connection

# Workflow overview - Zoho Community Center Announcement Bot
This workflow is for you to make a simple Zoho Cliq bot which will poll Zoho Community Center with some delay, and send you updates based on your interests/subscribed topics.
All you need to do is follow purple-note tutorial, and after you and your team will be able to have a nice automated messages about new Zoho Announcements!
